      "name": "affected_system",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable, reasonably balanced categories of the affected system; supports meaningful comparison of resolution time across systems."
    },
    {
      "name": "failure_symptom",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clear symptom categories (connection_failure, outage_down, access_denied...) that are external and can be segmented against resolution time."
    },
    {
      "name": "scope_qualifier",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable scope categories (general, remote_access, location_specific...); usable for grouping, though somewhat dominated by 'general'."
    },
    {
      "name": "resolver_match",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Boolean whether resolver matched assignee; interpretable segmentation that could relate to resolution time, though 100 NULLs weaken it."
    },
    {
      "name": "assignment_lag_present",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable boolean about assignment lag; a plausible associational variable, though heavily skewed (428 true vs 72 false)."
    },
    {
      "name": "caller_id_group",
      "role": "irrelevant",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Named 'group' but values are individual caller identities; high-cardinality identifier that is essentially a restatement of caller_id, not a meaningful segmentation."
    },
    {
      "name": "resolution_delay_proxy",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Bins based directly on resolution time (same_day, over_seven_days, unresolved); this restates the focus variable rather than providing an external relationship."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 6,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.6,
  "rationale": "Most added columns are genuine external, interpretable segmentation variables (incident_category, affected_system, failure_symptom, scope_qualifier, resolver_match, assignment_lag_present) that let a human group and compare resolution time. }
